summary: Iteration 4 — Added 13 new backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_photos.py covering the new face-photo check-in feature: (1) POST /api/sessions/start with a valid ~1KB JPEG data URL → 200, session.has_photo=true, GET /api/photos/session/{id} returns exact bytes with content-type image/jpeg; (2) start without face_photo → has_photo=false (backward compat preserved); (3) malformed base64 face_photo → start returns 200 with has_photo=false and no photo row created; (4) sub-512-byte decoded photo → has_photo=false (sanity gate honored); (5) GET /api/photos/session/{unknown} → 404; (6) unauthenticated fetch → 401; (7) tenant isolation — foreign-org owner receives 404 for another org's photo; (8) /api/sessions/live rows include has_photo boolean (true when photo uploaded, false otherwise); (9) WebSocket session.update payload includes has_photo=true; (10) geofence (403 outside) and accuracy (400 low-accuracy) checks are NOT bypassed by including a photo; (11) attendance record still has record_hash + prev_record_hash after a photo session lifecycle. All 13 new tests pass; combined with existing 33 tests (test_backend.py, test_websocket.py), total 46/46 pass when run serially. Under pytest.ini's -n 2 --dist loadscope, occasional cross-worker races occur on the shared seeded employee (same pre-existing race documented in iteration_3.json — the nigerian_office fixture across files fights for the single sample employee's office assignment).

minor.issue: pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope but three test files (test_backend.py, test_websocket.py, test_photos.py) all create a nigerian_office fixture that reassigns the SAME seeded sample employee and run cross-worker in parallel. This causes intermittent 'Session already active' / 'No office assigned' failures on employee session tests. Serial (-n 0) runs green. Recommend either (a) each file create+use its OWN dedicated employee, or (b) file-scoped filelock in the nigerian_office fixture.

action_items: (Low) Consider per-file dedicated test employees or a filelock in the nigerian_office fixture to make -n 2 --dist loadscope fully deterministic across all three session-touching test files.
critical_code_review_comments: services/photos.py: `save_session_photo` catches only base64 decode errors; a very-large valid base64 that decodes to a huge blob would still be inserted (limited only by Pydantic max_length=6_000_000 on the model, i.e. ~4.5MB raw). Consider also an explicit upper bound after decode (e.g., raw > 5MB → reject) to defend against future increases in max_length.
routes/photos.py: Cache-Control set to `private, max-age=300` — good. But there's no ETag / conditional GET; not blocking.

routes/sessions.py start route: photo save is followed by a second update_one to set has_photo=true — could be inlined into the initial insert doc to save a round-trip (compute has_photo first, then include in insert). Non-blocking.

photos._strip_data_url: relies on `mime = header.split(';')[0][5:]` and defaults to image/jpeg; if a user posts image/png data URL the mime is stored correctly, and get_photo returns it — good, no mismatch.
session_photos collection: no TTL index. Photos accumulate indefinitely. Consider a retention policy or TTL index on created_at for compliance/storage.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New test file: /app/backend/tests/test_photos.py — all classes consolidated into a single TestPhotos class to work with pytest.ini's -n 2 --dist loadscope. Helper _start_with_retry() tolerates transient 'Session already active' 400s from cross-worker contention. When adding more session-based tests, keep them under this single class (or create a dedicated new employee per file) to avoid xdist races. Tiny valid JPEG blob helper: _tiny_jpeg_data_url() → (data_url, raw_bytes) 1046-byte JPEG. Sub-512B blob helper: _small_valid_base64_under_512() for the sanity-gate test. WS test uses ws://localhost:8001/api/ws/live (ingress bypass).
rca of the issue: N/A — the new face-photo feature is implemented correctly and every specified behavior (upload, retrieval, tenant isolation, backward compat, malformed-input tolerance, sanity gate, has_photo propagation into /api/sessions/live and WebSocket broadcasts, and non-bypass of geofence/accuracy) is verified green. The only observed flake is the same pre-existing xdist cross-worker race on the shared seeded employee — mitigated by consolidating this file's tests into one class scope; the underlying shared-fixture pattern should ideally be refactored but is out of scope for a backend-only test iteration.
